leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a parent component that renders multiple child components
Implement props to pass data from parent components to child components
Apply component composition to build complex UI structures from simple building blocks
Configure components to accept and render children using the children prop
Manipulate component hierarchies by nesting components within each other
Integrate composed components within a React application structure
Render dynamic content by composing components with different data inputs
